feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cattle are 100% grass-fed and grass-finished, ensuring high-quality, flavorful beef.

notes: The Guilbeau family raises pastured broilers and grass-fed beef at Dubach. Checked the homepage, about page, practices page, products page and contact page. The products page says cattle are 100% grass-fed and grass-finished and poultry are moved to fresh pasture daily; the practices page says the animals get corn and soy free non-GMO feed, which appears to describe the poultry. Bulk beef is sold as quarter, half or whole with a deposit, and the farm contacts buyers to schedule a pickup or drop-off date; the Verifier may decide whether drop-off means local delivery. Orders go through the Barn2Door store, which I did not open. Contact page lists farm hours every day 9 am to 5 pm and no phone number. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary, not raw text.
